question: What beautiful round things do we wear on our wrists? ⭕
explanation: Awesome! Bangles are pretty circles that we love to wear on our wrists! ⭕

explanation: Great job! Many beautiful and shiny bangles are made of colorful glass. ✨

question: What shape is a glass bangle? 🟢
explanation: Super! Bangles are perfectly round so they can slip over our hands! 🖐️

question: When do we love to wear bright new bangles? 🎉
